fix: Do not collect into a Vec. hide_at() never touches OPEN_TOOLTIPS and invokes no callbacks, so the registry can be walked in place while borrowed. Replace the body of dismiss_other_hovered with: OPEN_TOOLTIPS.with(|open| { let mut open = open.borrow_mut(); open.retain(|weak| weak.strong_count() != 0); for weak in open.iter() { let Some(state) = weak.upgrade() else { continue }; if Rc::ptr_eq(&state, &self.state) { continue; } let controller = Self { state }; if !controller.is_kept_open() { let _ = controller.hide_at(now); } } }); The same helper shape can replace the collecting block in dismiss_all_at (lines 535-546). Behavior is unchanged: the self-skip, keep-open check and prune semantics are identical, and no per-event Vec is allocated.
The match is Option::map in disguise. Replace with: self.state.borrow().pending.map(|pending| match pending { PendingTransition::Show { at } | PendingTransition::Hide { at, .. } => at, })
